name: Death Facing
source:
Oli, a university student, wakes up in a strange facility alongside 7 other people and is forced to... work retail?  Can they trust the other players, or will they only depend on themself? Either way, they'll have to make it to the next shift, one aisle at a time.

[from [url=https://lametart.itch.io/death-facing]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
奥利，一名大学生，在一个陌生的设施中醒来，身边还有另外7个人，被迫……从事零售工作？他们可以信任其他玩家，还是只能依靠自己？无论哪种方式，他们都必须一次一个过道地赶到下一个班次。

[来自[url=https://lametart.itch.io/death-facing]Itch.io[/url]]
